issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, but the reference implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return int. This mismatch will confuse students about the expected return type (the textual instruction even hints to check the UML), and could lead them to implement the wrong signature and face compilation/test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across the artifacts. Either update the UML and problem statement to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (recommended), or change the solution (and any tests) to return String. Preferably modify problem_statement.md (the UML) to show +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and update any wording that points students to the UML, so students implement an int-returning method.
